text:
Rina: Dropping a short thread — updated compact filters + compare row mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact. Goal: reduce clutter, keep compare usable on 1024px. PTAL.

Omar: Nice direction. One ask: filters should collapse into a single compact row with chips that overflow into a popover. Avoid multi-line filter rows that push the table down.

Jules: A11y: collapsed chips need clear labels and keyboard focus. Popover should trap focus and be closable with Esc. Also ensure contrast for chip text >=4.5.

Kai: For compare rows, can we make badges single-line with icon + tiny label (e.g., "P95 120ms")? That keeps row height low. On small widths, show two badges and a "+N" control.

Sam: Pin UX: inline toggle in each row (no modal). Use star icon + aria-pressed. Tooltip: "Set default version for this project". Also add a "Manage defaults" in toolbar for bulk actions.

Rina: Sorting: add a small sort control in the toolbar that can sort by badge metric (latency/cost). But do not dynamically reorder the badges themselves — only reorder rows.

Omar: Mobile note: touch targets must remain 44px. If we compress badges, make the +N affordance large enough to tap.

Jules: SR announcement: when a default is set, update an aria-live region: "Version 2.1 set as default for Project X". Also make sure tooltips are accessible via keyboard focus, not just hover.

Kai: Implementation caveat: table uses virtualization. Inline toggles must be part of the virtual row render to avoid lost state when scrolled. Persist defaults server-side to keep state stable.

Sam: Copy tweak: change "Pin" to "Set default" across the UI. Short label on button: "Default" and tooltip with the longer explanation.

Rina: Agreed. I'll update Figma and add the a11y notes. Plan to demo in Thursday sync.
